exercises.name: Triplets to sixteenths, 4 and 4
exercises.detail: Four beats of triplets, then four beats of sixteenths, alternate picking, round and round. One string, muted or open.
exercises.intro: Triplets to sixteenths, four and four. Four beats of triplets, then four beats of sixteenths, alternate picking on one string. Keep the motion small and the switch clean.

exercises.name: Alternate picking, eighths
exercises.detail: Two notes a beat, down up. One string, muted or open.
exercises.intro: Alternate picking in eighths. Two notes a beat, down then up, on one string.

exercises.name: Alternate picking, triplets
exercises.detail: Three a beat; the pick direction flips each beat.
exercises.intro: Alternate picking in triplets. Three notes a beat, so each beat starts on the other pick stroke.

exercises.name: Alternate picking, sixteenths
exercises.detail: Four a beat. Picking small, cruise speed.
exercises.intro: Alternate picking in sixteenths. Four notes a beat. Picking small, at cruise speed.

exercises.name: 3's to 4's
exercises.detail: A beat of triplets, a beat of sixteenths, back and forth. Start on the G and B strings.
exercises.intro: Three's to four's. One beat of triplets, one beat of sixteenths, back and forth.

exercises.name: Speed bursts
exercises.detail: One bar of sixteenths at full speed, one bar off.
exercises.intro: Speed bursts. One bar of sixteenths as fast and clean as you can, then one bar off.

exercises.name: Accents, sixteenths
exercises.detail: Four a beat, the first of each louder.
exercises.intro: Accents in sixteenths. Four notes a beat, the first of each beat louder.

exercises.name: Accents, triplets
exercises.detail: Three a beat, the first of each louder.
exercises.intro: Accents in triplets. Three notes a beat, the first of each beat louder.

exercises.name: Gallop
exercises.detail: Eighth and two sixteenths: down, down up. Accent the first.
exercises.intro: The gallop. An eighth and two sixteenths: down, down up. Accent the first.
